Participants will be assigned to one of three groups called cohorts (Cohort 1, 2 or 3). Cohort 1 participants are further divided into Cohort 1A and Cohort 1B. In Cohort 1A, 3 participants will receive increasing doses once every 2 weeks with a visit to assess safety measures collected the week after dosing prior to escalating doses of BMN 351. In part 2, the participants in cohort 1A will transition to once weekly dosing. The participants in Cohort 1B, 2, and 3 will initiate low, medium, and high doses of BMN 351 and continue once weekly dosing at that same dose.
